questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are traveling the wrong way on a one-way street. Turn around carefully to avoid a head-on collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers not to enter an intersection if traffic is blocked. Only proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for making left turns. Do not use it to pass other vehicles or for driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is raised straight up, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a shared center lane that drivers from both directions can use only to make left turns. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow, and have black lettering or symbols. They alert you to hazards or unusual conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign points out that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. Slow down and be careful when you see this sign because construction work is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and look both ways for pedestrians and other vehicles. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn about work zones. This sign means workers may be on or near the road. Slow down and be extra careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that construction or hazardous conditions ahead require you to take a different route. Follow the detour directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road ahead will curve right first, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that the right lane ahead is closed due to construction. Be careful in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Expect to follow a redirected path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not have room to pass a truck safely, so be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Do not park in this area. Your vehicle will be towed if you do.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Slow down to safely navigate the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit if conditions are not ideal. Always adjust your speed for rain, snow, traffic, and other hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means large trucks are not allowed on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction zones. These areas are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that penalties for unsafe driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging into your lane, make room for them if it is safe. Move to another lane if possible to help traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign shows the direction traffic must travel on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this spot at any time, day or night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles displaying a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.
